repairs.behavior: QLockFile at canonical calibration_local.db.operation.lock covers both database commits and failed cleanup with 250ms bounded worker wait. Cleanup first rolls back old transaction state, reacquires BEGIN IMMEDIATE, reads all committed including hidden project/batch pairs, and releases only newly added keys with no persisted identity. Lock/read/cleanup failure keeps conservative holds and explicit reconciliation error.

data_contract.reference_protocol: catalog-reservations-v1 unchanged; adds conservative canonical dataset path binding in existing catalog_metadata
data_contract.ids: Existing dataset UUID, stable project_base.id and reagent_batch_group.id preserved; batchId0 has no batch hold
data_contract.history: No raw point, concentration/result unit, ratio, copied provenance, checked/applied, hidden-history or role semantic changes
data_contract.transaction_boundary: Local and catalog remain separate SQLite files. No cross-file FK or one atomic transaction is claimed.
data_contract.startup: Enabled gate exception is only historical read/protection reconciliation; save/copy/remove reject disabled project
data_contract.concurrency: All cooperating new-version CalibrationStore writers use bounded canonical operation lock. Explicit external file replacement/raw SQLite writers bypassing the application are outside this product operation protocol.

restore_contract.supported: Stop every store/process before restore; restore matching calibration/catalog data at the same canonical dataset file path, then run startup identity/hold reconciliation. Multiple connections to that same canonical file remain allowed.
restore_contract.different_path: Moving a dataset, a Windows/WSL/RK path change or cloning requires an explicit authorized migration after checking physical copies, dataset records and durable references. No automatic relocation/fork is provided.
restore_contract.prohibited_shortcuts: Do not directly delete holds, reset dataset UUID, silently replace path binding, or overwrite a live database to bypass protection.
restore_contract.rollback: The narrow source preimage restores source only. It does not migrate path bindings or runtime data. Older binaries that ignore the guards must not write a protected dataset; use read-only investigation until reconciliation.
